description: Owner of an NFT on Arbitrum One: the wallet that holds one ERC-721 token id right now (ownerOf), plus the collection's name and symbol. Use to verify who holds an NFT before a trade, a mint gate or an airdrop; for how many a wallet holds use arb_nft_balance, for the token's metadata arb_nft_metadata. A missing contract is 404, a token that does not exist 422, both uncharged. Example: contract=0xC36442b4a4522E871399CD717aBDD847Ab11FE88, tokenId=1. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: arb_nft_owner
title: NFT owner, Arbitrum
